name: Baked Whole-Wheat Gujiya
ingredients: Dough: ½ cup whole-wheat flour, 1 tsp oil, pinch of salt, water
steps: Knead the flour, oil and salt with water into a firm dough; rest for 20 minutes.
Mix the paneer, coconut, banana and cardamom into a thick filling.
Divide the dough into 6 balls, roll into thin circles, fill, fold into half-moons and seal the edges with a fork.
Place on a lined tray and brush with oil.
Bake at 180°C for 22–25 minutes, turning once, until golden.
note: Traditionally deep-fried with sugar and nut-filled khoya; this version is baked, whole-wheat, nut-free and sweetened with banana. Enjoy 2 as an occasional treat.
